messages.subject: Re: Help with Stan compiler on an AWS instance
parts:
Hi Jasper,

I think the free AMI instances have too little RAM to compile a Stan model with g++. The first thing to do would be to install clang++ from a shell via

sudo apt-get install clang++

Then, again from a shell, you need to tell R to use clang rather than g++ by executing

mkdir -p ~/.R
echo "CC=clang" >> ~/.R/Makevars
echo "CXX=clang++" >> ~/.R/Makevars

Even still, I'm not sure it would work and you may have to pay for more RAM.

Ben
